name: @paidfor/x402-policy
description: One line on your existing @x402 client: refuse sellers the paidfor index rates avoid before anything is signed, and report each payment's outcome to the index afterwards. No custody, no key handling, no new wallet.
author: Sarmad Siddiki

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if(process.env.PAIDFOR_PUBLISH_APPROVED!=='1'){console.error('Publishing @paidfor/x402-policy requires explicit human approval (set PAIDFOR_PUBLISH_APPROVED=1).');process.exit(1)}" && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && tsup
